title: Identical spectra, different couplings: the isoscalar/isovector and Lagrangian degeneracies of LZ's Table S6 and the coupling ratios that relate them
question: Which Table S6/S7 entries share identical xenon spectra (same response and q-power) versus merely similar ones, what coupling ratios map one entry's best-fit onto another's, why does the Table S6 significance pattern look as it does, and how many distinct spectral classes does LZ actually test?
headline_result: Derived NR reductions of L1-L20 reproduce LZ's five constant pairs and ten s/v degeneracies exactly; Table S6's 40 entries form 24 spectral classes (H<0.02), 14 among the 25 entries at >=3.0 sigma, matching corpus N_eff 12-14; coupling maps d4 = 4263 d20, d3 = 2132 d17, d2 = 2 d8, d19 = 1425 d11 at 1 TeV; L12, L16 (= O13), L6v, L9v are new classes; only L18v is unexplained (-0.7 sigma).
key_numbers: classes 24/22/21/19 at H<0.02/0.05/0.10/0.15 (Z>=3 subset 14/13/13/12; all 68 incl. O_i 34/31/29/19); H_sv <= 0.032 for LZ's ten declared vs >= 0.135 otherwise; LZ identical-pair scatter rms 0.12 sigma max 0.4; Z(N_lo) fit rms 0.25 sigma; N_lo L10 0.20, O6 0.40, L12 1.03/1.28, L6v 1.41, O13 4.7/9.0, O1s 2770
model_or_mechanism: NREFT Lagrangians L1-L20 (Anand et al.) reduced to O_i with q-dependent coefficients; nuclear responses M, Sigma', Sigma'', Delta, Phi'', Phi~'; low-energy companion count N_lo sets local significance
software_and_packages: python 3.12.13; WimPyDD 2.0.4; numpy 2.5.3; scipy 1.18.1; pandas 3.0.5; matplotlib 3.11.2; common/lzcommon.py
local_inputs: fulltext.tex (Theory, LEE, Tables S6/S7); PAPER_GUIDE; P003/P012/P027/P031/P032/P044/P057 papers; P057 details + cache (16 spectra); P016 Z(N_lo) curve; P057/P044 scripts; WimPyDD package.py; ledger; DR-001..003
recalled_knowledge: 8 items (3 likely, 5 certain, 0 uncertain): Anand Table 1 structure/order; Dirac bilinear NR reductions; Anand response coefficient functions; m_M = m_N; L10 reduction; O16 = q^2 O12 + O15 identity (derived); Hellinger/KL; (N-Z)^2/A^2
